title: I Still Need My Bottle
can_do: 说明自己基本准备好了但还缺水瓶，请求帮助、按位置线索找到并装好，再确认可以出发。

conversation_move.label: report readiness and one missing item

trigger: Dad asks about leaving while Child's open carry bag is ready but his water bottle is still on the nearby table.
core_response: I'm ready, but I still need my water bottle.
stretch_response: I'm ready, but can you help me find my water bottle?
repair_response: Wait, not yet. I still need my bottle.
setting: Inside the front door before a car ride, with the bottle and bag both within easy reach.
essential_props: one departure set: a capped water bottle and a small open carry bag

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I'm ready, but I still need my water bottle.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: It's on the little table beside you.

replay_cards.title: Missing sun hat
replay_cards.setting: Ready to go to the playground
replay_cards.change: Shoes are on but the sun hat is still on the bench
replay_cards.challenge: Say you are ready but still need the hat, ask Mom where it is, put it on, and confirm readiness

replay_cards.title: Missing library book
replay_cards.change: The bag is zipped before the library book goes in
replay_cards.challenge: Say what is still needed, reopen the bag, add the book, close it, and confirm readiness

parent_support: Ask a genuine readiness question and wait when the child names a missing item.
Give one useful location clue when asked. Let the child retrieve and pack the bottle before the final readiness check.
